Angry caller: 2 Sep analysis 'one calming reply', 9 Oct recap mail draft 'two' vs Selin's correction in the 9 Oct recap and the 8 Oct analysis 'three calming replies, then agent': used three.

Out-of-scope questions: 2 Sep analysis and 8 Oct analysis 8.4 (straight to main menu) vs 7 Oct session + 9 Oct recap (ask 'Size bu konuda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarmamı ister misiniz?', yes -> menu, no -> continue): used the recap.
Three failed tries: 2 Sep 'Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum' vs 7 Oct / 8 Oct 'Size şu anda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.': used the later sentence.
Same last four digits: 2 Sep analysis (ask the full number) vs 7 Oct / 8 Oct / 9 Oct recap (last six first, then full number): used last four -> last six -> full number.
Currency names: 2 Sep table ('TL') and Ozan's 10 Oct suggestion ('Sterlin') vs Elçin/Kerem 7 Oct and 10 Oct: always full names Türk Lirası, Dolar, Euro, İngiliz Sterlini.

Card number masking: 8 Oct analysis says the services return masked numbers vs 9 Oct recap (production returns the full number): the agent never says more than the last four digits and sends cardNumber exactly as cards.list returned it.

Statement week limit: IVR prompt sheet / FAQ ('once a month, three times a year', 'up to three times a year') vs Kerem 7 Oct (once per calendar year): used once per calendar year, mentioned in the options sentence; no service flag exists, so the change is always offered.
Joint statement warning: 2 Sep analysis (after the confirmation question) vs 7 Oct session / 8 Oct analysis (before 'Onaylıyor musunuz?'): the warning is said before the question.
Other-card question vs offer order: 10 Oct session (ask 'Başka bir kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek ister misiniz?' before the offer) confirms 8 Oct: used other-card question first.
Card with no statement yet: 10 Oct session: say there is no statement debt because no statement was cut, plus the first statement date only if the service gives it; never invent a date.
Statement cut day: 10 Oct session: 'Hesap kesim tarihiniz bugün, ekstreniz saat 00.00 itibarıyla kesilecek.' first, then totalDebt per currency.
No-eligible-card sentence: 2 Sep 'yönlendiriyorum' vs 8 Oct 'aktarıyorum': used 8 Oct.
Statement by e-mail: FAQ (any address) vs analysis / kickoff mails (only the registered address, only the latest statement): used the registered address and the latest statement only.
Third-party card: 8 Oct analysis says send the caller back to the IVR login step vs example scenario 5 (security sentence, then main menu): used the security sentence and the main-menu hand-back.
Second-factor box in the flow drawing: never built (Burcu 28 Sep, Selin): no identity check in the agent.
